Keep every moving brass seam inside its green blueprint band throughout the 20-second lighting inspection. Each window has different trim linkages. Click a lettered seam badge to inspect which numbered rail drives it and in which direction; discovered labels stay visible. Inspecting before START is safe, and inspecting during the run is read-only. Each committed trim decision advances one fixed 0.10-second physics slice; waiting between decisions leaves the visible display unchanged. Use the trim rails to counter fan pressure and inertia. simplified.summary: Click a position on a trim rail to set its signed drive and commit one fixed physics slice. Click the same seam badges to inspect the same seeded rail linkages without advancing time.

full.summary: Drag each brass trim lever to preview the identical signed drive; release commits one fixed physics slice. Click the same seam badges to inspect the same seeded rail linkages without advancing time.
